subject: 清初至清中北方王府前院模块（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Texture and detail this architectural blockout into one realistic early-to-mid Qing north China princely courtyard building sprite. CRITICAL pixel-locked orthographic camera: keep EXACT same ground-contact outer quadrilateral and its straight edges as input. Do NOT reposition, enlarge or recenter the layout. On this 1536x1024 image the left ground corner stays(128,520), foreground corner(832,872), right ground corner(1408,584), rear(704,232). Width22m depth18m. Both planar axes have identical absolute 0.5 slopes. In particular front-to-right goes up by288px and right576px, never steepen it. This geometric silhouette is immutable. Replace plain blockout surfaces with photorealistic fine gray brick, small green glazed roof tiles, dark red timber lattice door/window frames, minimal blue-green beam painting, elegant stone paving. Rear hall is a Chinese tiled gable hall; two side wings; a modest decorated front gate. Fine realistic historical construction, weathering and detail density for a high-resolution Chinese RPG map, not stylized low-poly. Roof eaves modest; no dragon motifs or imperial yellow tiles. Keep front courtyard boundary a single straight line except the doorway, no projecting stairs or irregular base. Camera, entire footprint, flat base level and upright verticals fixed to input, only architectural detail changes. Upper-left sunlight, very small lower-right contact shadow. No background plane, haze, bloom, halo, atmospheric shadow, people, signs, letters, watermark or numbers. True transparent RGBA outside the silhouette with fully opaque building interior; do not add gray/black background. One complete building with all tips visible.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚地台、裁切、透视汇聚、黄色帝王琉璃瓦
created_time_basis: 本轮归档PNG本地mtime；非工具披露的服务端时间

paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding
